Interface VirtualServer

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Subinterfaces:
VirtualServerRMI, VirtualServerSocket
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientRMIConnection, SocketClientConnection, SocketServerHandler
public interface VirtualServer extends Remote
Protocol-agnostic contract for everything that can act as a server endpoint, i.e. an object a client is able to send a command to. Both the socket and the RMI implementations ultimately implement this interface, so a client can issue commands without knowing the underlying transport. It extends Remote so the same contract can be exported through RMI.
